summary: Bug found in supposedly verified income carry logic
detailed_context: Nick is reporting a bug in the income carry calculation—the AI claimed the work was 'built, verified, and committed' with '129 tests pass,' but the carry is showing negative when it should be positive. While his tone is neutral/direct (no anger), this represents a clear failure of the verification claim. This is a correction that needs fixing, putting it in the 3-4 range. The calm delivery doesn't hide the disappointment that a supposedly finished, tested feature has a logic error.
